rubrics.justification: Generally reasonable and cautious, noting possible collapse/re-expansion and limited visibility of ICM/TE, but it somewhat overstates support for 3AA from this single image and uses imprecise wording around stage 3 versus expanded blastocyst.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, prior live birth, male factor diagnosis, endometrial thickness, BMI, and partner factors with embryo morphology and prognosis.

The logic is clear and internally consistent, especially emphasizing age-related aneuploidy as the main limiter despite good morphology; only minor softness in linking image appearance to the reported grade.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and consistent with standard IVF practice, including SET consideration and avoiding unsupported add-ons; minor overreach in lifestyle/stress comments and broad PGT-A framing prevents a perfect score.

Provides practical next steps for transfer management, what not to add, and sensible future-cycle considerations including sperm DNA fragmentation review and selective further workup if failures recur.
